title: 1967 AHSME Problem 8
statement: To \(m\) ounces of an \(m\%\) solution of acid, \(x\) ounces of water are added to yield an \((m-10)\%\) solution. If \(m\gt25,\) then \(x\) is:

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: not determined by the given information

solutions.text:
Conservation of acid gives \[ \frac{m^2}{100} =\frac{m-10}{100}(m+x). \] Hence \(m^2=(m-10)(m+x),\) so \(10m=(m-10)x\) and \[ x=\frac{10m}{m-10}. \]

Therefore, the correct answer is A.
hints: The amount of acid remains \(\frac{m^2}{100}\) ounces
Set that equal to \(\frac{m-10}{100}\) times the final volume \(m+x\)
